[***Economics and Statistics***]{.journal} · 2021

\[[Article](https://www.insee.fr/en/statistiques/5432533?sommaire=5432550)\] · \[[Data (FRDB)](https://frdata.org/en/french-regional-income-database/)\] · \[[Media coverage](../media.qmd)\]

> *Reconstruction of average fiscal income per French department since 1922 from Ministry of Finance archives. We document a significant reduction in interdepartmental average fiscal income inequality over the last century.*
